intelligence.simple_view: Today we learned two hundred fifty-seven things, and we squeezed them down into twenty-seven big lessons — like squeezing a whole bag of oranges into one glass of juice. The finish line is Personal, then Hub, then Dashboard, then Membership — one at a time, each whole. And a note is only done when it is live where people can find it — not when it is filed, but when it is on the page.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — two hundred fifty-seven notes came in today, dear, and we boiled them down to twenty-seven lessons, the way you boil a big pot of stock down to the good rich part. The finish line is Personal, then Hub, then Dashboard, then Membership — one at a time, each whole, love. And a note is only done when it is live where people can find it — not when it is filed, dear, but when it is on the page.
intelligence.naya_view: I distill ten into one, every day, and I never skip a day. When the machine refuses, I finish by hand and say so plainly — which group failed, what the error was, which groups were machine-filed, which were hand-distilled. I never claim a note is live on the Hub until it is on the page. And the note is only done when it is live.
